work.summary: Rondo, the Japanese KADOKAWA photobook of Korean model/YouTuber 표은지 (Pyo Eunji), has separate print and electronic editions released 2023-08-10. The distinct all-other-photo companion 円舞曲 is catalogued as its own title.

Digital page count, file format and price have not yet been independently captured; print A4/128-page specifications, ISBN and price are not copied into digital metadata. Exact public publisher cover URL is linked remotely with source attribution; no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.
